fields.statement: Scratch build of HEAD run as a root daemon over a sandbox root of six projects (HOME and RHIZA_* isolated, web on 127.0.0.1:18931). With only the daemon's machine-wide load-high hold active every project's count was 0 in the header and /picker (hold not counted). A real failed run in zeta (workflow with a failing command step, run start --foreground) made zeta's header badge and picker count 1, the other five stayed 0, matching rhiza inbox in zeta.

Scratch build of HEAD run as a root daemon over a sandbox root of six projects (HOME and RHIZA_* isolated, web on 127.0.0.1:18931). GET /picker?path=/p/beta/roadmap listed all six projects with idle state and counts, beta aria-current, links kept the page kind (/p/x/roadmap; /p/beta/runs/<id> gave /p/x/runs; no path gave /p/x/), All projects linked /inbox, search field present at six projects; with zeta's failed run zeta sorted first and All showed 1. Unknown project or bad path query render cleanly (200, nothing current); POST /picker 404. Project pages' markup names no other project.

Scratch build of HEAD run as a root daemon over a sandbox root of six projects (HOME and RHIZA_* isolated, web on 127.0.0.1:18931). /p/beta/, /p/beta/runs and /p/beta/roadmap each served wordmark, picker button (data-rz-picker=/picker, current project name), Home/Runs/Roadmap nav with aria-current on the current page and the live indicator; no badge when nothing waits, badge 1 on zeta with a failed run; no other project's name in the page. Served CSS: --header-h 52px, phone header min-height 56px with the nav on a 44px row. The merged /inbox and /projects pages have no picker button (finding recorded); the daemon pill shows on Home only.
